evidence.title: GitHub - ripienaar/free-for-dev: A list of SaaS, PaaS and IaaS offerings that have free tiers of interest to devops and infradev

name: free-for.dev
summary: Community-maintained list of SaaS, PaaS and IaaS services that offer free tiers for developers, devops and infrastructure engineers.
description: A long-running list of software and services with free developer tiers, from major cloud providers and source code repos to APIs/data/ML, CI/CD, testing, security and collaboration tools. Built from pull requests by 1600+ people and maintained in the ripienaar/free-for-dev GitHub repository, published as the free-for.dev website.
contains: SaaS, PaaS and IaaS offerings with free developer tiers
sections: cloud providers, code repos, APIs/data/ML, artifact repos, CI/CD, testing, security, auth
